proposal.summary: FileCloud versions prior to 21.3 are vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) that allows creating an administrative user via an authenticated administrator's browser when cookies use SameSite=None and Secure over HTTPS, by POSTing a CSV import to /admin/?op=import.

C.quote: Creat hacker user with Password1 via CSV file upload.

I.quote: Creat hacker user with Password1 via CSV file upload.

A.quote: Creat hacker user with Password1 via CSV file upload.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability in a test environment, confirm whether the import action requires administrator privileges, and check cookie SameSite/Secure settings; if confirmed, publish advisory and provide patch or configuration mitigation (set SameSite to Lax/Strict or enforce CSRF tokens).
